items.title: Carrier Global (CARR) May Find a Bottom Soon, Here's Why You Should Buy the Stock Now
items.summary: Carrier Global (CARR) appears to have found support after losing some value lately, as indicated by the formation of a hammer chart. In addition to this technical chart pattern, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher enhances the stock's potential for a turnaround in the near term.

items.title: Carrier Beat Estimates, Raised Its Outlook, And Fell Anyway
items.summary: The market looked past a small earnings beat to a profit that is still shrinking and a raised target that leans heavily on the back half of the year.

items.title: Carrier (CARR) Appoints Neil Barua To Board As Tech Focus Comes Into View
items.summary: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) has appointed technology executive Neil Barua as an independent director. Barua will serve on the Compensation Committee and the Technology & Innovation Committee. The appointment adds experience from his leadership roles at PTC Inc. and ServiceMax to Carrier Global's board.
